messages:
Maya: Follow-up on the RFC: I'm calling the approach 'RBAC shield' 14 an early, cheap rejection layer that trims candidates before the tile materializer. Goal: reduce materialize CPU and tail latency for dashboards that scan large lists. Quick sketch and rollout plan below. Thoughts?

Rahul: +1 for the name. Main tradeoff: extra lookups and cache invalidations. Need to quantify read amplification and hit/miss ratios.

Liz: Safety first: the shield must never be the final gate. Final per-item check must still run right before we serialize sensitive fields. Otherwise we risk leaking on cache staleness.

Maya: Agreed. Contract: shield is a filter that can only reduce the candidate set. Final evaluation runs unconditionally for returned rows.

Omar: Implementation idea: two modes: early_reject (boolean mask per-entity) and early_hint (score that orders candidates so materializer can process top-K first). early_hint could help paginated views.

Kevin: Nice. For early_hint, we can store a small 8-bit score in the prefilter index so materializer prioritizes high-score rows. That reduces work if clients only request first page.

Rahul: Data plane considerations: we can put shield state in Redis with keys: rb_shield:v{perm_version}:{tenant}:{entity_id} -> bitmask|score. Invalidation via policy-change events bumps perm_version. This avoids per-entry deletes on role flips.

Liz: Need to add tests for perm churn. If a role is revoked, canary tenants must reflect deny immediately. We should run a canary test that flips a role and asserts that final eval denies within N seconds (N depends on invalidation path).

Maya: Telemetry we want (naming conventions): console.rbac_shield.candidates_before, console.rbac_shield.candidates_after, console.materialize.rows, console.rbac_shield.invalidation_latency_ms, console.rbac_shield.false_positive_rate. Add an SLI: shield_reduction_ratio = 1 - (candidates_after / candidates_before). Alert if reduction_ratio < 0.1 for 10m.

Omar: Also track final_authorizations_post_shield to ensure no regression in correctness. If (final_authorizations_post_shield / canonical_authorizations) deviates we should alert.

Kevin: Ops: we should expose a debug endpoint to dump shield decisions for a tenant/query id. Use it during canary only. Must be gated by admin auth.

Maya: Rollout plan: feature-flagged in three phases:
1) dry-run: compute shield and log but do not use results. Collect false_positive_rate and reduction_ratio.
2) soft-on: apply shield to reduce materialization but always run final eval; if final eval differs, increment a mismatch counter and fall back.
3) hard-on: use shield to prune, but still run final eval before serializing. If mismatch rate > 0.001 over 1h, auto-toggle to soft-on and page oncall.

Rahul: We need a perf loadtest: create synthetic tenant with wide permission distribution and real-world query shapes. Baseline vs dry-run vs soft-on. Measure e2e p95, CPU, and materialized_rows.

Liz: Config sketch (proto):
```
rbac_shield:
  mode: dry_run | soft_on | hard_on
  ttl_seconds: 30
  perm_version_key: perm_gen
  score_decay: true
  fallback_on_mismatch: true
```

Maya: Can we piggyback on existing policy-change webhook to publish perm_gen bumps? If so we can avoid a new bus.

Omar: Yes, control-plane already emits policy_update events. We should extend the payload with perm_gen. Edge caches can subscribe.

Kevin: SRE note: ensure Redis adds are sharded by tenant to avoid hot keys. Also watch memory growth; keep shield entries compact (bitmask or uint8).

Rahul: Also evaluate a bloom-filter layer for the full-tenant set for low-memory cheap checks. Bloom only for existence checks; never for allow checks.

Liz: Security policy: any returned row must have an audit header if shield was used (x-rbac-shield: applied=true, version=42). Helps debugging and compliance.

Maya: Can someone pick up the telemetry dashboard? Need panels: shield_reduction_ratio over time, materialize_rows, mismatch_rate, invalidation_latency.

Omar: I'll add dashboard tiles under Console/RBAC Shield.

sre-bot: Canary window scheduled: 2025-06-11T02:00Z -> cluster-console-canary. Ticket RBACSHIELD-11 created.

Maya: Ok I'll open the follow-up PR with interface + Redis schema + canary playbook. Sync tomorrow 11:00 to review PR. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
